description: This header file declares external functions related to the Access Manager component of the Advanced Networking Service Container (ANSC). It provides prototypes for creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions for the Access Manager object.

methods.name: AnscCreateAccessManager
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Access Manager, taking container, owner, and reserved handles as parameters.

methods.name: AnscAmoCreate
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new Access Manager object with specified container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: AnscAmoRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the specified Access Manager object.

methods.name: AnscAmoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the necessary sub-objects or components into the Access Manager object.

methods.name: AnscAmoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Access Manager object, setting default states or configurations.
